review_scope.method: Independent semantic review against glossary blocked_future_concepts and teaching facts. No generator reasoning or prior evaluator findings consulted; deterministic gates not rerun.
review_scope.text_coverage: Exhaustive over step titles, ledes, prose, recap and remediation text, visual labels and annotations, code walkthroughs, media summaries and bridges, and up-next labels, including nested visual text.
review_scope.interaction_sampling: Stratified across all ten tiles, including choices, code exercises with fixed scaffolds, and transcript/classification tasks. Reviewed sampled prompts, options/items, public workspace code and feedback.

boundary_decisions.explanation: The script-directory search-path fact is explicitly part of the local-modules glossary teaching. These steps do not require the later module-search-path diagnosis concept. Package teaching follows its own explainer within this tile.

getLogger(__name__), sys.path inspection, explicit environment invocation, and -m pip list are taught by their current glossary concepts. Understanding the later main-entry-point, sys runtime-information, interpreter-selection, or pip-installation concepts is not necessary here.

Advanced adapter code is explicitly fixed and left unchanged. In the entry-point task, iter()/next() occur only in the fixed input adapter; the learner binds familiar input/int/print functions. Neither sampled task requires understanding later iterator or generated-code-review concepts to complete the stated learner action.

A .venv path in the runtime diagnostic alternatives is merely a supplied string, not a prerequisite to recognizing actual sys observations. The assert statement appears only in the next-tile title and is not explained or tested.

summary: No reviewed text or sampled interaction requires understanding a blocked future concept. Future-topic labels, supplied path strings, and explicitly fixed adapter implementation details do not constitute needs-to-understand leakage.
